spec: Add a glossary page docs/glossary.md that defines every DDF term used in docs/concepts, one entry per term, alphabetically sorted, each linking to the concept page that uses it.
acceptance: docs/glossary.md exists and starts with a one-line purpose and a Status line
every term in the glossary links to at least one page under docs/concepts

agentDefaults.question: Should the glossary include adapter names?
agentDefaults.choice: Yes, one entry per V1 adapter, linking to docs/adapters.
